presentation.tagline: Passionate about technology, design, and digital experiences. I enjoy continuously learning and exploring new ways to build modern, accessible, and intuitive interfaces.

journey.title: My journey
journey.description: My journey in technology started in 2022, when I was accepted into Driven Education's Full Stack program. During this period, I built a solid foundation through hands-on projects, weekly challenges, and teamwork.

experience.title: My experience
experience.description: My first professional opportunity was in the financial sector, where I spent three years developing internal applications. This experience strengthened my perspective on software engineering and product development.

motivation.title: What drives me
motivation.description: I found in Front-end development the space where I can combine creativity, technology, and software engineering. My goal is to build modern, accessible, and performant digital products using best practices in architecture, scalability, security, and sustainable development, balancing technical excellence with a consistent user experience.

skills.subTitle: Technologies and tools that make up my development stack.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.description: Worked on web application development, contributing to both front-end and back-end solutions. Experience with React, Node.js, REST APIs, microservices, automated testing, and messaging services in a corporate environment.
achievements: Technically led the evolution of the internal accounting portal after the Front-End developer's departure.
Automated processes with filters and responsive forms, eliminating manual queries and accelerating data analysis.
Maintained and evolved an ecosystem of 11 microservices responsible for the monthly accounting closing process.
Designed automated tests with Jest and Cypress, increasing test coverage to 90% and ensuring successful Azure DevOps pipeline execution.
Resolved critical incidents by analyzing Front-End, BFF, and Back-End layers as an integrated system.
Collaborated with teams and provided technical mentoring to an early-career professional.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.description: Development of a cinema application focused on front-end architecture, user experience, and a complete ticket purchasing flow. The project simulates a real-world booking platform, integrating API consumption, state management, form validation, and data persistence.
achievements: Designed a complete ticket purchasing flow covering session selection, seats, products, payment, and confirmation.
Implemented global state management with Zustand and checkout persistence using localStorage.
Developed forms with React Hook Form and Zod, ensuring consistent data validation.
Modeled different seat types, including standard, accessible, and companion options.
Integrated the application with the TMDB API to consume and display movie data.
Structured the application with a focus on componentization, code reuse, and separation of responsibilities.
